issues.description: The type of the Person.id field is inconsistent across the problem statement, the template, and the solution. The problem statement and the provided template use UUID for Person.id and the server endpoints expect UUID path variables for personId. However, the solution's common Person model uses Long for the id while the solution's server code (PersonService and PersonResource) still uses UUID. This mismatch is structural and will prevent the project from compiling and will confuse students about which ID type to use for implementing endpoints and client requests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.id type consistent across all artifacts. Prefer aligning with the problem statement and template by changing the solution's common Person model to use UUID (java.util.UUID) for id, and ensure all usages (PersonService, PersonResource, and client code) handle UUID consistently. Alternatively, if Long is preferred, change the problem statement, template service/resource signatures, and all usages to Long so the type is uniform across template, instructions, and solution.

issues.description: The conceptual identity of Person.id is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template model use UUID for Person.id, but the solution's Person model uses Long for the id field. Furthermore, the solution's server components (PersonService and PersonResource) still use UUID in method signatures and id generation. This creates a confusing mapping for students (which type is the canonical Person identifier?), and in the solution it produces an internal mismatch between the Person model and the server code that expects UUIDs.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the Person identifier type across all artifacts. Preferred fix: use UUID everywhere (update the solution's Person model to use UUID as in the template and problem statement) and ensure PersonService and PersonResource consistently accept and produce UUID ids. Alternatively, if Long is intended, update the problem statement, template model, and all server/client code to use Long consistently. Ensure PersonService's id generation and PersonResource path variable types match the Person model type.
